level.title: Beginner
level.tagline: Start here if React is new to you
level.description: Learn React from zero: what React is, how JSX works, how to build components, pass props, hold state, handle events, and render lists and forms.

tutorials.title: React Introduction
tutorials.description: What React is, the problem it solves, how it updates the screen, and how to write your very first component.

chapters.title: What Is React?
chapters.description: The problem React was built to solve and why so many teams reach for it.

chapters.title: How React Updates the Screen
chapters.description: Elements, the virtual DOM, and what actually happens when state changes.

chapters.title: Setting Up a React Project
chapters.description: The realistic ways to start a React project today, and what each one gives you.

chapters.title: Your First Component
chapters.description: Write, render and edit a real React component in the browser.

tutorials.title: JSX in React
tutorials.seoTitle: JSX Tutorial: Syntax, Expressions and Attributes
tutorials.description: How JSX works, how to put JavaScript values inside markup, how attributes differ from HTML, and how fragments let you return several elements.

chapters.title: What JSX Is
chapters.description: The syntax extension that lets you write markup inside JavaScript, and what it compiles to.

chapters.title: Embedding Values in JSX
chapters.description: Curly braces, which values render, and which quietly disappear.

chapters.title: Attributes and Styling
chapters.description: Why it is className not class, and how the style prop differs from a CSS string.

chapters.title: Fragments and Structure
chapters.description: Returning several elements, self-closing tags and the rules JSX enforces.

tutorials.title: Components and Props
tutorials.description: Split a UI into components, pass data down with props, use children for composition, and understand why props are read only.

chapters.title: Thinking in Components
chapters.description: How to break a screen into components and where to draw the lines.

chapters.title: Passing Props
chapters.description: How data flows from parent to child, and why props cannot be changed by the child.

chapters.title: Children and Composition
chapters.description: The children prop, and using components as slots instead of piling on options.

chapters.title: Props in Practice
chapters.description: Spreading props, forwarding the rest, and building a reusable component.

tutorials.title: State with useState
tutorials.seoTitle: React useState Tutorial: Managing Component State
tutorials.description: Add memory to a component with useState, understand why updates are asynchronous and batched, and learn the rules for updating objects and arrays.

chapters.title: Why State Exists
chapters.description: The difference between a value that survives a render and one that does not.

chapters.title: Updates Are Asynchronous
chapters.description: Why the value does not change immediately, and what batching means for your code.

chapters.title: Objects and Arrays in State
chapters.description: Why you must replace state instead of mutating it, and the patterns for doing so.

chapters.title: State in Practice
chapters.description: Sharing state between components and building a working counter.

tutorials.title: Events and Conditional Rendering
tutorials.seoTitle: React Events and Conditional Rendering Tutorial
tutorials.description: Handle clicks, keys and form submissions with React's synthetic events, then show and hide parts of the UI based on state.

chapters.title: Handling Events
chapters.description: Attaching handlers, the synthetic event object, and passing arguments.

chapters.title: Conditional Rendering
chapters.description: Ternaries, logical AND, early returns and when to use each.

chapters.title: Conditional Styling and Remounting
chapters.description: Toggling classes, and how keys decide whether React reuses or rebuilds an element.

chapters.title: Putting It Together
chapters.description: A short review of the pieces and how they combine into an interactive component.

tutorials.title: Lists, Keys and Forms
tutorials.seoTitle: React Lists, Keys and Forms Tutorial
tutorials.description: Render collections with map, choose keys that will not bite you, and build controlled forms with validation and submission.

chapters.title: Rendering Lists
chapters.description: Turning arrays of data into arrays of elements.

chapters.title: Choosing Keys
chapters.description: What keys are for and why the array index is usually the wrong choice.

chapters.title: Controlled Inputs
chapters.description: Binding form fields to state so React is the single source of truth.

chapters.title: Submitting and Validating
chapters.description: Handling submit, showing validation messages, and a full working example.

pageProps.description: Learn React from zero: what React is, how JSX works, how to build components, pass props, hold state, handle events, and render lists and forms.
